title: Just Intonation
description: Simple whole-number ratios used as musical intervals and chords.

title.label: Title
title.heading: Just Intonation
title.body: Just intonation builds intervals from precise whole-number frequency ratios. It turns the harmonic relationships you hear in overtone structures into a practical tuning language for scales and chords.

lab.label: Lab
lab.prompt: Try mapping simple ratios onto a scale.

choices.text: Its frequency relationship can be described by a simple whole-number ratio.
It always equals one step in 12-EDO.
It is generated only by stacked perfect fifths.

items.title: Identify a ratio
items.body: Choose one interval such as 5/4 or 7/4 and write what makes it useful musically.

items.title: Compare with equal temperament
items.body: Describe one way a just interval differs from its nearest equal-tempered approximation.
